Macro.Name: MLAGO
Macro.Note: For use to auto photograph function emulated from MA3 console. Don't alter any plugins or macro lines, otherwise system will not work!!

MacroLine.Name: CueNo
MacroLine.Guid: 0D 49 20 00 F4 CB 61 74 D1 DF 7F 1D 05 4B CD C4
MacroLine.Note: Assigns the variable CNO to the current cue no.

MacroLine.Name: Duration
MacroLine.Note: Scans current cue duration across parts

MacroLine.Name: Photo_1
MacroLine.Note: Triggers 1st OSC goto cmd to MLA + Reformats the cue no. to work in SendOSC string

MacroLine.Name: SetWait
MacroLine.Guid: 0D 49 20 00 CD DA 4D 69 B2 43 C4 0E FD 74 CD C4
MacroLine.Note: Uses highest current cue duration, to assign emulated duration to re-go cue in MLA.

MacroLine.Name: AdjustTimer
MacroLine.Guid: 0D 49 20 00 6B 7F BD 20 FD C4 DD 09 F1 74 CD C4

MacroLine.Name: PhotoTime
MacroLine.Note: Placeholder line, only for modular wait time for additional SendOSC cmd

MacroLine.Name: Photo_2
MacroLine.Note: Triggers 2nd goto cue OSC cmd, to trigger the auto photo in MLA
